item.tib: snyan rgyud rtsa khrid mun sel shel phreng
item.coloph: bder gshegs dgongs rgyud dgu grub thob nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ sprul sku drin chen gnyis/ zhang zhung smar gyi grub chen drug spu rgyal bod kyi grub thob gsum/ rtogs ldan dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ 'or sgom kun 'dul khu dbon gnyis dang lnga/ bka' brgyud bla ma bdun rim par brgyud nas/ bdag rang grol bla ma rgyal mtshan gyis/ dbang lung man ngag rtsa rlung yig chung dang bcas pa rnams rim par rdzogs par thob/ rtsa rlung man ngag lag len khrigs kha 'di/ gangs sta sgo shel bar/ gnas chen nyi ma long du/ bdag rang grol bla ma rgyal mtshan gyis sgrigs (bsgrigs) pa lags/ bder gshegs rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dbal mo dang*/ bon skyong srung ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ rdzogs chen snyan rgyud lag len 'di/ 'gro don nyi zer bzhin du rgyas par shog bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog/
